biotools.summary: IQ2MC is a framework that integrates IQ-TREE 3 and MCMCTree for phylogenetic time tree inference, enabling the use of complex models and significantly speeding up the pre-calculation steps. It facilitates a seamless workflow for estimating divergence times with greater accuracy.
